key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often usage is collected in the background.

key.name: window-days
key.description: The period the cost breakdown covers: 1, 7 or 30 days.

key.name: panel-mode
key.description: Claude's session limit when available, otherwise the highest limit's percentage, the window's cost, or the icon alone.

key.name: panel-limit-source
key.summary: Which providers' limits the panel shows
key.description: Show Claude, Codex, or both when the panel mode is Limit percentage.

key.name: providers
key.description: JSON list of usage sources: [{"id", "kind": "claude"|"codex", "name", "color": "#rrggbb"|null, "home": config directory or "" for the default, "enabled"}]. An empty list collects every installed CLI from its default directory.
